hooks.command: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ "$(git config core.hooksPath)" = ".githooks" ] || echo "GUARDRAILS OFF: git config core.hooksPath is not .githooks. Tell the user and offer: git config core.hooksPath .githooks (then bash tests/test_git_guardrails.sh)."; b=$(git branch --show-current); case "$b" in main|integration/*|lab/*) echo "ON PROTECTED BRANCH $b: do not commit here. Start a topic branch: git switch -c <name>/<topic> origin/lab/main.";; esac; [ -n "$LAB_SITE" ] || echo "LAB_SITE is not set: the deploy skills need it (see the lab-setup skill)."; exit 0'
